description: Improves an article staged with cotal_draft_post. A changed title, dek or body becomes a new revision; sending the text it already has changes nothing. Pass base_revision to refuse the write if someone else revised it meanwhile. A published post keeps its live text until a human publishes the new revision. Requires a team key.

base_revision.description: The revision you edited; the write is refused (409) if the post moved past it.

body.description: The full new markdown body (not a diff).

note.description: One line on what this revision changes; shown in the revision history.

restore.description: Make an earlier revision current again instead of sending new text.

status.description: pending submits it for human review.

name: cotal_update_post
title: Revise a staged article
